retention.image: Keep exactly the tag registered in shared.json for as long as this profile exists; a superseded Strata tag is removed reference-aware, never with a blanket prune.
retention.model: The UD-IQ4_XS shards are retained only while this profile is registered; retiring the profile releases them to the library retention pass like any other revision.
retention.workspace: ai/strata-trial/data holds the engine pack, its MTP layer and its own logs; it is bounded by the engine and is removed with the profile.
retention.reports: Trial measurements go to ops/reports/<date>-strata-trial and follow the existing reports aging convention.

labels.local-ai.retention: reference-aware: tag, model revision and workspace are released with the profile

mtp.detail: the engine's own MTP draft layer, installed with its state on first start; automatic drafting is left on

deployment_warnings: Trial profile: it is reached through its own service alias, trial, and never through daytime, local-active or nighttime, so it is never a default and never shadows the selected profile. Only an operator who chose this configuration sends trial.

While this profile is active the catalog offers no daytime service at all: daytime is genuinely absent, not merely another name for this backend, and a request for it fails as MODEL_NOT_FOUND. A client that only ever sends daytime has nothing to send until a Daytime profile is selected again.

Strata is not llama.cpp: it configures itself from the environment, keeps its own pack, logs and MTP layer in ai/strata-trial/data, and needs a writable root. Unrestricted output is stated because the deployment sets no output ceiling; it has not been attested on this quant, which is a plain Qwen release rather than an unrestricted fine-tune. nsfw is therefore false.
Exclusive profile: Nighttime is stopped and removed while this profile is active; requests for it fail until a paired Daytime profile is selected.

Four text cards only (RTX 3090, RTX 4080 SUPER, RTX 4080, 3080 Ti) with auto layer placement; the RTX 3080 is not in this container at all, so this backend serves no vision and the shared projector path is idle.

Prompt chunks are doubled to 16384 tokens (STRATA_PREFILL_AUTO_MAX; the engine's own default is 8192). Every expert a chunk routes to is streamed once per chunk, so a bigger chunk moves fewer bytes per prompt token, and PCIe is what this box is short of: two PEX8747 switches put each GPU pair behind one x16 uplink, about 7.9 GB/s per card, which the engine itself reports as pcie_frac 0.22. The engine still refuses a chunk whose buffers the expert cache cannot lend, so this raises a ceiling and does not force an allocation.
160K is the total prompt, history, reasoning, and output capacity.

A fresh container reads all 94 GB of its shards before it answers, because the engine keeps its verified-checksum markers in its own tree rather than beside the read-only model files; the readiness window allows for it.
